Bbr Partners Has Upped Its Facebook (FB) Stake by $856,240; Hrg Group (HRG) Share Value Declined While First Trust Bank LTD Boosted Holding
May 26, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
First Trust Bank Ltd increased its stake in Hrg Group Inc (HRG) by 45.15% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Trust Bank Ltd bought 87,526 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.45% with the market. The institutional investor held 281,380 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.77M, up from 193,854 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Trust Bank Ltd who had been investing in Hrg Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.59B market cap company. The stock increased 1.03% or $0.13 during the last trading session, reaching $12.75. About 1.64 million shares traded. HRG Group, Inc. (NYSE:HRG) has declined 24.44% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 35.99% the S&P500.
Bbr Partners Llc increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 183.38% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bbr Partners Llc bought 4,865 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund held 7,518 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.33M, up from 2,653 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bbr Partners Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $535.28 billion market cap company.
